request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle strings, hopeful and peaceful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not burn with anger over evildoers
Do not envy those who do wrong
For like grass they will soon wither
And fade like the green of new growth

[Verse]
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land and make faithfulness your pasture
Take your delight in the LORD
And he will give you what your heart asks

[Chorus]
Make faithfulness your pasture
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land with steady heart
And he will give you what your heart asks

[Verse]
Commit your way to the LORD
Trust in him and he will act
He will bring out your righteousness
Like the light and your justice like the noonday sun

[Chorus]
Make faithfulness your pasture
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land with steady heart
And he will give you what your heart asks

[Bridge]
Be still before the LORD
And wait patiently for him
Do not burn with anger over the one
Whose way prospers and carries out his schemes

[Chorus]
Make faithfulness your pasture
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land with steady heart
And he will give you what your heart asks

[Outro]
Trust in the LORD and do good
Make faithfulness your pasture
